gui.concertstage.console_help_1: 1. Link speakers with the Audio Link Tool (right-click a speaker, then the console).
gui.concertstage.console_help_2: 2. Import an MP3 or WAV: "Import…" button, or drop the file on the game window.
gui.concertstage.console_help_3: 3. Playlist: click a track to select it, click again to play. ▲ ▼ move it, ✕ removes it.
gui.concertstage.console_help_4: 4. ⏮ ▶ ⏸ ⏹ ⏭ control playback, ↻ repeats. Click the bar under the title to jump in the track.
gui.concertstage.console_help_5: 5. Mixer: MST = whole console, then one fader per group (L, R, SUB, FF, DLY, CUS). M = mute.
gui.concertstage.console_help_6: 6. The meters next to the faders show the real level: green fine, orange loud, red too loud.
gui.concertstage.console_help_7: 7. Equaliser: tone of the console for everyone. Linked speakers: click the coloured box to change the group.
gui.concertstage.console_help_8: 8. What you change here is heard by every player. "Sound settings" only changes your own listening.
gui.concertstage.console_help_9: Rest the mouse on any button to see what it does.
gui.concertstage.console_help_close: Click anywhere to close this help.
